CS2040S requires CS1010 and CS1231. CS1010 and CS1231 can be Sem 1. But CS2040S is Sem 1 or 2. If taken in Sem 1, it needs CS1010 and CS1231. It must be Sem 2 or later. Therefore, CS2109S (Sem 1 only) cannot be taken because its prerequisite CS2040S cannot be completed before Sem 1. Thus, CS2109S is impossible to take. What about CS3244? MA1511/MA1512 can be Sem 1. EE2012 Sem 2. CS2040S Sem 2. CS3244 Sem 2? No, CS3244 prereq CS2040S. CS2040S is Sem 2. So CS3244 must be Sem 3 or later. But CS3244 is only offered Sem 1 and Sem 2. So CS3244 is impossible to take. Therefore, CS4248 cannot be taken. Thus, no plan exists.)
